evidence: Frozen tests/ hashes match manifest. tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the template: [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] 0.6/0.2/0.2 (sum 1); [floors] functional=0.05; each name has its directory (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual). tomllib parse of all five judge.toml: [judge] keys are only judge/mode/timeout/isolated/prompt_template/mcp_servers (no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight); judge='claude-code' fallback; every file has the playwright stdio server with the template args; only scored/functional/judge.toml:23-27 declares the 'verifier' server (/usr/local/bin/python3 /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py $APP_RESTART_HELPER), and test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER (test.sh, restart_mcp.py and score.py are byte-identical to the template). Gates: all_pass, 1 binary criterion each. Functional: weighted_mean, 16 binary criteria, unique ids, weights positive sum 42.0 (matches comment line 35). Polish: 6 binary, weight 1.0. Visual: 4 likert points=5 with 5..1 anchors, weights 2/2/1/1. No empty names/descriptions, no duplicate ids, no stray criterion keys. Every prompt_template prompt.md exists and contains {criteria}, {app_context} and localhost:3000; test.sh:198-200 substitutes app_context by literal replace and rewardkit build_prompt uses tmpl.replace('{criteria}',...), so the braces in app_context.md:24 cannot break resolution. Only template deviation: functional mode='individual', timeout=550 (template batched/9000). I verified in the pinned harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (models.py JudgeMode=Literal['batched','individual']; judges.py _arun_agent_individual runs one agent call per criterion sequentially, with judge.timeout per call; MCP args go through os.path.expandvars) that this is a supported, well-formed mode. restart_mcp.py:29-31 enforces single use with a file marker, so it holds across the per-criterion sessions. Budgets nest: gates 600+600<1500, scored 16x550+900+900=10600<11100, 1500+11100=12600<task.toml verifier 13200. Weak-app or alternative check: this structural wiring cannot be passed by a broken app, and it does not penalize a conforming one. Risk=true because no full configured RewardKit run on these bytes has exercised the individual-mode functional suite, including the restart server across 16 sessions and the real per-criterion durations. raw-evidence-index.json states that no full grading run was made. The judge.toml comment says 'Not yet measured against a judge run'. Retries (_MAX_JUDGE_RETRIES) on CLI errors could push serial time past the 500 s headroom. That is unmeasured and belongs to the workload rows.
